summary: Corrected the "recieved" typo to "received" in the missing e-mail validation message in forms/validate.py and added a regression test pinning the exact message. Tests went from 2 to 3 passing, and no misspelling remains in source.
assumptions: The misspelling exists only in the user-facing message, so changing it is the whole fix.
No caller or test depends on the old misspelled text (verified by grep).
No canonical docs, style guides or decision records exist in the repo, so none were consulted.
Adding one regression test is proportionate to the risk and is in scope.
